entries.name: Aurora
entries.lineage: Round 1 concept 1 — warm modern firm, later reworked to a 'column banking-precision' light palette

entries.name: Courtroom

entries.signature: Gold cursor spotlight, word-by-word kinetic headlines, blinking-cursor serif hero, sticky horizontal-scroll process section
entries.description: Editorial, literary dark theme — 'an NYT-Magazine profile of a courtroom drama'. Near-black ink with cream type, rationed gold and oxblood, thin-weight Cormorant Garamond display and rule-line structure.

entries.name: Courtroom v2
entries.lineage: iteration 2 of courtroom — same palette, adds ProcessSection/ProcessVariants experiments and SpectrumMatrix
entries.signature: Courtroom look with alternative horizontal-process section variants trialled
entries.description: Refinement pass on Courtroom: identical dark ink/cream/gold/oxblood tokens, but the process section was rebuilt in multiple scroll variants and the dispute spectrum matrix was introduced.

entries.name: Courtroom v3 (Spotlight)

entries.signature: Gold cursor spotlight over the full courtroom system: kinetic serif headlines, sticky horizontal process, spectrum matrix

entries.name: Mosaic
entries.lineage: Round 1 concept 3 — 'Atlas Card' sapphire system
entries.signature: 3D-tilt bento cells, magnetic buttons, blend-mode custom cursor, draggable horizontal timeline
entries.description: AI-startup polish on a serious firm: pure-black canvas stepped through grey surfaces (depth by tone, never shadows), a single brightened sapphire accent and hairline white borders.

entries.name: Ledger
entries.lineage: Round 2 refined concept 1 — 'End Your Dispute.' archival case-file
entries.signature: Indexed case-file layout: numbered sections 00–08, coordinate markers, monospace accents, barely-there verdigris focus wash
entries.description: A near-monochrome editorial law-journal on warm parchment (never pure white): graphite ink, faint hairlines and a Legora-style indexed grid. Type does the heavy lifting — Cormorant Garamond display over Inter body.

entries.name: Verdict
entries.lineage: Round 2 refined concept 2 — 'Two sides. One resolution.'
entries.signature: Split-screen duality hero — two full-bleed obsidian sides with text hugging the central seam, one signal-red accent
entries.description: Obsidian tonal steps (no pure black surfaces) with exactly one signal red for CTAs and highlights. The split-screen layout dramatises two parties resolving into one structured space.

entries.name: Atrium
entries.lineage: Round 2 refined concept 3 — 'Resolve with clarity.', refined toward a Parloa warm-paper reference
entries.signature: Airy architectural spacing on uncoated cream paper; highlighter-orange used ONLY as outline/underline/icon-stroke, never fills; near-zero radius, flat surfaces
entries.description: Light, open and architectural — warm cream canvas with linen banding, hairline rules and Fraunces display. Clarity and relationship-preservation expressed as generous whitespace and zero shadows.

entries.name: Quill
entries.lineage: Round 2 refined concept 4 — 'In the matter of your dispute… let it be resolved.'
entries.signature: Manuscript/letterpress formality: parchment wash, Cormorant SC small-caps, animated quill progress and a wax-seal motif, oxblood selection
entries.description: The most formal voice — a legal document rendered as a warm paper manuscript. EB Garamond body (self-hosted via next/font), small-caps display accents, oxide-red and antique-gold details.

entries.name: Meridian
entries.lineage: Round 2 refined concept 5 — 'From conflict to resolution.', earlier star-field build kept in archive/
entries.signature: Directional journey layout: starfield + constellation waypoints with mouse glow guiding the eye from conflict to resolution; CTA-forward with the phone number front and centre
entries.description: A cosmic dark theme — pure space black with panel tones, a violet 'gold' accent and teal counter-tone. Ultra-thin Newsreader display headlines over a scroll-driven waypoint journey.

entries.name: Clause
entries.lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6) — the living contract
entries.signature: A living contract that writes, signs and resolves itself as you read: ink underlines, quill trails, 1px ledger rules, paper-speckle texture
entries.description: Warm parchment manuscript with ink-black type and a single rationed oxblood seal-red for signature, seal and one CTA, plus faint gold hairlines. Flat separation by rules only — never heavy shadow.

entries.name: Constellation
entries.lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6) — palette distilled from the Dala reference
entries.signature: Particle cosmos: thousands of tiny line-drawn shapes on a fixed canvas that cluster, scatter and re-form from conflict into resolution
entries.description: Pure black void, bone type, violet pulse and amber/lichen illustration tints. The whole page floats over a generative constellation canvas.

entries.name: Convergence
entries.lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6) — marries Verdict's split layout with Equilibrium's force-lattice art
entries.signature: Two parties (ash + red threads) weave into one behind the Verdict-style split-screen measure layout, under a legibility vignette
entries.description: Obsidian surfaces with the single signal-red scheme, a living force-lattice breathing behind Caslon serif headlines. Uses Verdict's .measure container grammar over a fixed canvas.

entries.name: Equilibrium
entries.lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6); its ForceLattice art was saved separately for future exploration
entries.signature: Two opposing force-fields — teal vs amber nodes on a flow field — resolve into one woven lattice on scroll; the cursor weaves and brightens nearby threads; agreement links in indigo
entries.description: Cool architectural dark with depth from tone only: night-blue surfaces, hairline grid, electric indigo bridging CTAs between the two party hues.

entries.name: Tribunal
entries.lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6) — the living scales of justice
entries.signature: A brass balance whose scales tip and settle into equilibrium as you scroll, one warm metallic gold for scales + CTA, faint cool blue counter-tone
entries.description: Near-black void with tonal charcoal surfaces and whisper-weight Cormorant Garamond display gravitas. The animated brass scales carry the whole identity.

entries.name: Law Firm Navy Premium (v5)

entries.description: Traditional premium law-firm look: cream body with deep navy hero/section bands, antique gold accents, and a double-serif system (Cormorant Garamond display over Source Serif 4 body).
